component.name: Tide
component.summary: A source-aware native music library and player

description.p: Tide scans real music, preserves every playable copy, and explains whether a track is here, streamable, or currently unavailable.
Its persistent queue, playlists, GStreamer playback, and MPRIS controls work across Luma desktop and handheld presentations.

Tide can also add a Navidrome or other Subsonic-compatible server as a source, keeping its library browsable alongside local music. Sign-in details are kept only in the system keyring, and a server Tide can't currently reach stays in the library, ready to try again.
